title: LLM Retrieval & Agent Systems
summary: A retrieval-QA system and agent tool-calling server built to compare retrieval strategies and long-running agent memory designs.
bullets: Built a LangChain retrieval-QA system using MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with dense passage retrieval over dual encoders and MMR re-ranking; benchmarked RAG-Sequence against RAG-Token.
Implemented an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing tool endpoints for agent function-calling, and evaluated MemGPT-style memory architectures for long-running agents.
